title: Intune Android Management API (AMAPI) Migration — Legacy Play EMM API → AMAPI
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Microsoft Android implementation).

Intune admin center / Microsoft Graph / managed Google Play / Google Admin console authored at exact detail from Microsoft & Google public docs. The Android Management API (AMAPI) transition, web/account-driven enrollment, and whether a change triggers device RE-ENROLLMENT are actively evolving — cited or flagged 'verify against current Microsoft guidance / your tenant', never asserted from memory or invented. OEM (Samsung Knox/Zebra) + third-party apps at the pattern level. Automation is PowerShell (Graph); no hardcoded credentials/secrets. No client names.
hook: Migrate Intune Android management to the Android Management API (AMAPI) cleanly
problem: Microsoft is moving Intune Android Enterprise management from the legacy Play EMM API to the Android Management API (AMAPI) — and teams need to know the migration approach, the end-user impact, and whether devices re-enroll. This solution is the AMAPI migration playbook: assess your current Android estate and enrollment models, plan the wave, execute the migration (including the newer web / account-driven enrollment path), validate account add and app delivery, and handle the common post-migration failures — with every version-specific behavior verified against current Microsoft guidance, not assumed.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — what AMAPI is, how it differs from the legacy Play EMM API, the enrollment methods affected (incl. web/account-driven), and the end-user / re-enrollment impact model.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Intune + Android Enterprise, the managed Google Play binding, admin roles, a pilot fleet, endpoints).

Assessment & Migration Guide — inventory current management + enrollment models, plan the migration wave, execute (with the web/account-driven enrollment method), validate, and expand — pilot-first; re-enrollment and behavior flagged 'verify against current Microsoft guidance'.

5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Microsoft Graph / Intune automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
Validation gates (migrated devices manage under AMAPI, accounts add, apps deliver) plus Best Practices for a low-disruption migration and post-migration troubleshooting pointers.
short: The AMAPI migration playbook — assess the Android estate, plan the wave, migrate off the legacy Play EMM API to the Android Management API (incl. web/account-driven enrollment), validate, and handle end-user + re-enrollment impact — verified against current Microsoft guidance. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
